estimator: Within each of five blocks, subtract the r=1 median from the condition median; report the median of the five block effects. δ uses hot-rank dispatch-done-to-expert-done CUDA time and ΔT uses cross-rank-max layer time.
model_status: legacy diagnostic ablation only; this hot-rank-only model omits dispatch changes, non-hot ranks, and last-ready switching
negative_effect_policy: Measured negative baseline-subtracted values are retained. When a cluster interval spans zero, it is compatible with a zero effect and its sign is not identified; hinge predictions remain nonnegative by definition.
